mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.tenant_id,COALESCE(r.business_no,r.refund_no) AS refund_no, COALESCE(o.business_no,r.order_no) AS order_no,COALESCE(r.approval_business_no,r.approval_ref) AS approval_no, COALESCE(p.business_no,r.receipt_no) AS receipt_no,CAST(r.amount AS CHAR) AS amount_minor, r.currency,r.status AS state,r.updated_at FROM tc_refund r JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.id=r.order_id JOIN tc_payment_receipt p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.id=r.receipt_id AND p.order_id=r.order_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.id=#{id} AND r.updated_at<=#{cutoff} AND r.status IN('SUCCEEDED','REJECTED','FAILED','EXPIRED')

SELECT kind,source_id,occurred_at,type,result,reference,relation FROM ( (SELECT 'CHANNEL' AS kind,CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS source_id, COALESCE(c.processed_at,c.received_at) AS occurred_at,c.observation_kind AS type,c.status AS result, COALESCE(c.business_no,c.callback_no) AS reference,'REFUND' AS relation FROM tc_refund r JOIN tc_refund_callback c ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.refund_no=c.refund_no WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.id=#{id} ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT 'APPROVAL',CAST(a.id AS CHAR),a.created_at,'ACCEPTED',r.approval_decision,a.receipt_no,'REFUND' FROM tc_refund r JOIN tc_refund_approval_receipt a ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.refund_no=a.refund_no WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.id=#{id} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT 'RETURN',CAST(t.id AS CHAR),t.updated_at,'AFTER_SALE',t.status,COALESCE(t.business_no,t.return_no),'ORDER_ITEM' FROM tc_refund r JOIN tc_return_request t ON r.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND r.order_id=t.order_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.id=#{id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tc_refund_item i WHERE i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.refund_id=r.id AND i.order_id=r.order_id AND i.order_item_id=t.order_item_id ) ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}) ) refs ORDER BY occurred_at,kind,source_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.recorded_at FROM tc_audit_attempt_outcome o JOIN tc_audit_operation_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND a.id=o.attempt_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND o.resource_id=#{refundNo} AND a.action_code<>'refund.audit.list' ORDER BY o.recorded_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_refund_audit_archive_batch() VALUES(#{batch.tenantId},#{batch.batchId},#{batch.refundId},#{batch.refundNo},#{batch.schemaVersion}, #{batch.factsFrom},#{batch.factsUntil},#{batch.factCount},#{batch.objectKey},#{batch.objectVersion}, #{batch.sha256},#{batch.payloadBytes},#{batch.payload},#{batch.state}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_id=tc_refund_audit_archive_batch.batch_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tc_refund_audit_archive_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{refundId} AND sha256=#{sha256} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM tc_refund_audit_archive_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM tc_refund_audit_archive_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND state IN('CLAIMED','UPLOADED') ORDER BY created_at,batch_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_refund_audit_archive_batch SET state='UPLOADED',object_version=#{version} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND state='CLAIMED'
UPDATE tc_refund_audit_archive_batch SET state='VERIFIED',payload=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND state='UPLOADED' AND object_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT g.ticket_id,g.batch_id,g.expires_at FROM tc_refund_audit_archive_grant g JOIN tc_refund_audit_archive_batch b ON b.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND b.batch_id=g.batch_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.ticket_id=#{ticket} AND g.actor_key=#{actor} AND g.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND b.state='VERIFIED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_refund_audit_archive_restored(tenant_id,ticket_id,batch_id,payload,expires_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{grant.ticketId},#{grant.batchId},#{payload},LEAST(#{grant.expiresAt},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)+INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_id=incoming.batch_id,payload=incoming.payload,expires_at=incoming.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.payload FROM tc_refund_audit_archive_restored r JOIN tc_refund_audit_archive_grant g ON g.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND g.ticket_id=r.ticket_id JOIN tc_refund_audit_archive_batch b ON b.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND b.batch_id=g.batch_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.ticket_id=#{ticket} AND r.batch_id=g.batch_id AND g.actor_key=#{actor} AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND LEAST(r.expires_at,g.expires_at)>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.state='VERIFIED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tc_refund_audit_archive_restored WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY expires_at,ticket_id LIMIT 200
